title: Halting simulation with bounded time
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be a Boolean oracle language, and let $x$ and $u$ be Boolean words. For any configuration $c$ of $N$ on input $x$, suppose an added tape with content $T$ and head position $p$ satisfies $T(p+i)=u_i$ when $i$ is a nonnegative integer less than the length of $u$, and is blank otherwise. Then there is a time $s\le 2|u|+2$ at which the constructed deterministic oracle machine, started from the configuration formed by adding this tape to $c$, has halted; its output is the output of the run of $N$ on $c$ using choice word $u$ if that run has halted, and otherwise is that output followed by the Boolean symbol false.
